title: Dynamic combinatorial/covalent chemistry: a tool to read, generate and modulate the bioactivity of compounds and compound mixtures
abstract: Dynamic combinatorial/covalent chemistry is an efficient tool to assess the complexity of biological and chemical systems. It has been used for receptor assembly, drug discovery, dynamic resolution, generating self-sorting and self-replicating systems, preparing biomimetic polymers and for the transport and release of bioactive compounds.
